title: Shifter Multiplexer
statement: Create a multiplexer that selects among four 8-bit shift-related values: the original input, input shifted left by one, input shifted right by one, and bitwise inverse. The selection is controlled by sel. This unit demonstrates a datapath selection stage.
module_signature: module shifter_mux(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input [1:0] sel, output [7:0] y);
behavior: Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not infer sequential state or registers.
hint: Use separate combinational expressions for each option.
